name: [Katagami] The durable activity rollup has stopped writing
message:
A per-user activity rollup dispatch failed. This is the layer meant to outlive Datadog's ~15-day log retention, so while it is down you are losing durable per-user history that cannot be reconstructed later.

Causes in order of likelihood: the katagami-commons spec was un-installed or its pin moved, Temper is unreachable, or the Cedar policy on MemberActivityDay changed.

Check the pinned ref matches production, then dispatch RecordMcpCall by hand against /tdata/MemberActivityDays to see the real error.

Logs: https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Akatagami-server%20env%3Aproduction%20%40evt%3Aactivity_dispatch_failed
